settings.title: Raw materials
settings.text: A Corvo rug can be made in [materials_count] materials, from wool and eucalyptus fibre to mohair and vicuña. A rug can be made in one material or mix several.
settings.image_alt: Hanks of undyed yarn, the raw material of a Corvo rug

settings.note: The price per m² follows the craft level of the design. The price guide shows it for each level and material.

settings.title: Included in the price
settings.text: Part of the price per m² of every rug.

settings.title: With a supplement
settings.text: These add a percentage to the price per m².

settings.title: Premium fibres
settings.text: Rare fibres, priced as a multiple of the price per m².
A lyocell yarn made for contract projects such as hotels, offices and shops.
A polyester yarn made for contract projects such as hotels, offices and shops.
The fleece of the Angora goat: a lustrous, resilient fibre that takes colour deeply.
An extra-long-staple cotton from the West Indies, among the finest cottons: smooth and soft, with a natural sheen.
The fleece of the vicuña, a wild relative of the llama from the Andes: one of the finest and rarest natural fibres.

settings.title: Pile and texture
settings.text: The pile is the surface of a rug: the yarn you see and walk on. How it is cut, and how high it stands, changes the look and the feel.
settings.image_alt: Close view of a rug that combines cut pile and loop pile in blue, green and white

settings.label: Cut pile
settings.value: The loops of yarn are cut open, for a soft, even surface. In our collections, from [cut_pile_range].

settings.label: Loop pile
settings.value: The loops are left closed, for a firmer, more textured surface. In our collections, from [loop_pile_range].

settings.label: Cut and loop
settings.value: Both in one rug, at different heights, so that the design stands in relief.

settings.label: High pile
settings.value: A pile above [pile_limit] mm adds [pile_percent]% to the price.

settings.label: Carving
settings.value: A relief cut into the pile once the rug is tufted. It adds [carving_percent]% to the price.

settings.title: See and touch before you decide
settings.text: A [sample_size] sample of any rug costs [sample_price]. It shows the real material, pile and colours.
settings.image_alt: A Corvo sample box beside a terracotta vase, on a cream rug
